counting_policy: Count unique bytes only after license/provenance review, successful download, integrity verification, schema validation, deduplication and acceptance. Remote advertised size, source size, compressed size and locally admitted bytes must be reported separately.

sources.known_lineage: Augmented from GSM8K and MATH training sets; source card states that test sets were not used.
required_checks: pin immutable source revision and verify license file at that revision
download train split only
deduplicate against existing Drosophila shards and all declared upstream sources
audit source/type distribution and repeated templates
validate answer/solution completeness and mathematical consistency on a stratified sample
exclude any overlap with local holdouts

sources.known_lineage: Dataset card reports source aggregation including GSM8K, MATH, olympiad, forum, translated and synthetic subsets.
required_checks: resolve license discrepancy against an immutable upstream revision and all source materials
inspect source breakdown and identify duplicate/overlapping source datasets
train split only; never import test split
audit OCR, translation, synthetic subsets and mathematical correctness
exclude any overlap with local holdouts

sources.known_lineage: MetaMathQA declares GSM8K training data among its augmentation sources.
required_checks: use only train split for any future ingestion
compare exact and semantic overlap with MetaMathQA before counting
keep test split outside all training and curation outputs

sources.revision: main (must pin immutable commit before ingestion)
sources.reported_size: 54.8 TB full dataset; sample-350BT documented at approximately 388 GB
sources.ingestion_plan: Prefer sample-350BT as a first bounded tranche; stream or download only the declared config and record exact bytes and source commit.
sources.rights_caveat: ODC-By covers the database. Source webpages originated in Common Crawl and retain their own rights; do not describe all underlying page content as individually CC-licensed.
required_checks: pin exact Hub commit and dataset config
preserve URL/domain/date/source metadata and ODC attribution
review Common Crawl terms and content rights caveats
cross-deduplicate against DCLM and current corpus
run language, quality, PII, safety and contamination filters
record compressed and expanded byte counts

sources.revision: main (must pin immutable commit before ingestion)
sources.ingestion_plan: Select deterministic shards to reach the remaining byte budget after the FineWeb tranche; do not mirror the full 7.2 TB by default.
sources.rights_caveat: Dataset card marks CC-BY-4.0 and research-baseline use; preserve attribution and check source terms/provenance before redistribution.
required_checks: pin exact Hub commit and selected shard list
preserve CC-BY attribution and source metadata
cross-deduplicate against FineWeb and current corpus
audit quality, PII, safety and benchmark contamination
record exact shard hashes and byte counts

sources.revision: collection snapshot must be pinned per constituent dataset
sources.reported_license: Public domain and openly licensed; varies by constituent source
sources.ingestion_plan: Select only constituent sources whose individual license and provenance are explicitly documented; never treat the aggregate label as one blanket license.
sources.rights_caveat: The aggregate is not a single license. Record the exact license, attribution and source for every constituent.
required_checks: inventory all constituent collections
exclude any component with unclear, non-commercial or incompatible terms
pin each source revision
preserve per-document source/license metadata
deduplicate and audit content

sources.reported_license: 193 permissive source-code licenses; per-file original license applies
sources.ingestion_plan: Select a bounded subset by language and file size; retain SPDX license and repository provenance for every file.
sources.rights_caveat: Not a blanket MIT/Apache dataset license. Each file remains governed by its original permissive license and attribution requirements. Keep opt-out removals current.
required_checks: use v1.1 license allowlist and exclude weak-copyleft files
preserve SPDX and repository provenance
apply current opt-out/removal list
scan secrets, malware, generated/vendor code and duplicates
retain per-file license notices

sources.revision: main; pin immutable commit before acquisition
sources.ingestion_plan: Inspect the exact Hugging Face payload/configuration and acquire only identified train shards after pinning the matching source revision.
sources.rights_caveat: GitHub repository license is Apache-2.0; verify that the distributed dataset payload is covered by the same license and resolve upstream source lineage before importing.
required_checks: pin immutable Git commit and dataset payload revision
verify payload-specific license and source lineage
identify and exclude validation/test/evaluation splits
deduplicate against Mathlib4, current synthetic math shards and all holdouts
audit formula integrity, language, OCR and answer correctness
preserve attribution, source IDs and per-record hashes

sources.revision: main; pin immutable commit before acquisition
sources.ingestion_plan: Review task-specific generation scripts and upstream datasets; only materialize task partitions with independently compatible rights.
sources.rights_caveat: Apache-2.0 applies to repository code; README describes composition from upstream datasets. It is not evidence that every embedded or downloaded source record is Apache-licensed.
required_checks: pin commit and enumerate every task/source dataset
verify upstream license for each source and derived annotation
exclude any evaluation split and benchmark contamination
preserve per-task provenance and attribution
audit generated reasoning correctness and exact/near duplicates

storage_policy: Do not commit multi-gigabyte corpora to Git history. Keep immutable manifests, source revisions, checksums and curation reports in Git; keep bulk data in an explicitly configured object store or dataset host. GitHub Actions runners/artifacts are for bounded staging and audit, not permanent 500 GB storage.
